question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A person who always looks at the negative side of things.'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pessimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pessimist"** refers to a person who tends to focus on the negative side of situations, expecting unfavorable outcomes. (निराशावादी)
 
 
• **Example:** A pessimist might believe that the new project will fail even before it begins.
 
 
 
• **"Optimist"** refers to someone who always looks at the positive side of things, expecting favorable outcomes. (आशावादी)
 
 
• **Example:** An optimist would see the cloudy weather as a chance for a refreshing rain.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to describe a person who always looks at the negative side of things is **'Pessimist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pessimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Optimist** (आशावादी): A person who always looks at the brighter side of life.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the challenges, an optimist believes that things will eventually get better.
 
 
 
• **Determinist** (नियतिवादी): Someone who believes that all events are determined by causes external to will or choice.
 
 
• **Example:** A determinist might argue that our actions are controlled by societal forces rather than free will.
 
 
 
• **Realist** (यथार्थवादी): A person who accepts situations as they are and deals with them practically.
 
 
• **Example:** The realist acknowledged the difficulties ahead but prepared accordingly.
